# TrustLayerLabs — API Security Testing & VAPT Consultancy

> TrustLayerLabs is an offensive cybersecurity consultancy specializing in manual API security testing, Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), SOC 2 & ISO 27001 readiness, and cloud security audits for SaaS, FinTech, and AI startups.

## Key Services
- [API Security & Penetration Testing](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services#api-security): OWASP API Top 10 manual testing, BOLA/IDOR detection, JWT security analysis, and rate-limiting validation.
- [VAPT for Web & Cloud](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services#vapt): Full-stack vulnerability assessment, web application security, cloud IAM & CIS benchmark audits.
- [SOC 2 & ISO 27001 Readiness](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services#compliance): GRC gap analysis, policy drafting, evidence collection, and vendor security review.
- [VAPT Bangalore](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/vapt-bangalore): Manual API & web security testing for Bangalore tech startups.
- [VAPT Hyderabad](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/vapt-hyderabad): Specialized API & cloud penetration testing for Hyderabad tech teams.

## Technical Capabilities & Differentiators
- **Approach**: Practitioner-led manual security testing focused on business logic, authorization flaws, and developer remediation.
- **Turnaround Time**: Standard reports delivered in 5–10 business days; expedited preliminary triage available for urgent deadlines.
- **Retesting Policy**: Retesting included to verify applied developer patches.
- **Compliance Alignment**: Actionable technical reports for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and enterprise vendor security questionnaires.
- **Registration**: MSME / Udyam Registered (Govt of India), listed on Skill With Boost.
